context: Refining the exit-intent 'Try for ₹49' trial popup on the CoinQuest landing page to be vibrant, parent-friendly, eye-catching, and aligned with CoinQuest playful card-playful brand identity.

typography.eyebrow: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-extrabold text-[#5B21B6] bg-[#F3E8FF] border-2 border-[#5B21B6]/30 px-3 py-1 rounded-full
typography.price_badge: text-sm font-bold bg-[#FFD23F] text-[#1D3557] px-3 py-1 rounded-lg border-2 border-[#1D3557] shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_#1D3557]

layout_strategy.type: Split-Card Playful Popup (Poptin Inspiration adapted to CoinQuest)
layout_strategy.mobile: Single column vertical stack, mascot/badge on top with organic purple/yellow blob background, text + CTA below
layout_strategy.desktop: 2-column grid layout (40% illustration blob on left with purple/sky blue background curve, 60% text copy + price badge + CTA on right)
layout_strategy.container_styling: bg-white rounded-3xl border-4 border-[#1D3557] shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_#1D3557] overflow-hidden p-0 max-w-2xl

instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign /app/frontend/src/components/ExitIntentPopup.jsx to match the split-layout illustrated style requested.
Ensure DialogContent uses max-w-2xl or max-w-xl with border-4 border-[#1D3557] and offset drop shadow shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_#1D3557].
Left side: Use a playful rounded blob background in soft purple (#F3E8FF) or sky blue (#E0FBFC) containing the cute CoinQuest mascot image / hero-earner image and a '₹49 1-Day Trial' floating badge.

Right side: Add a 'WAIT! BEFORE YOU GO' purple/yellow eyebrow pill, bold Fredoka headline 'Give Your Child the Gift of Money Smarts!', 3 micro checkmark benefit points, ₹49 price highlight, and a thick-bordered, punchy coral CTA button.
Include data-testid on every interactive element (cta button, close button, popup container, eyebrow).
Keep all original functional behavior intact (sessionStorage key 'coinquest_exit_intent_shown', mouseleave event listener, 45s mobile fallback, and 'coinquest:buy-now' custom event trigger).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered plain white dialogs.
Never use dark gradients or transparent backgrounds without backdrop protection.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Ensure contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards (dark navy text on yellow/white/purple-light, white text on coral button).
Maintain response speed and clean React code structure.
